Symposium on Drug Threats Highlights Forensics and Chemsex

An international symposium on emerging drug threats commenced at Bharat Mandapam, with the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) emphasizing the role of forensics. The NCB also issued a nationwide warning regarding a drug trend known as 'chemsex'. The event focused on identifying and combating new challenges in drug trafficking and abuse.
